newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian shoots two Israelis, Arab at border.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian shoots two Israelis, Arab at border.

text.p: A Palestinian woman crossing into the Israeli-occupied West Bank from Jordan on Sunday shot and wounded an Israeli security man, a soldier and a Palestinian woman, police said.
"The security man was hit in the shoulder and the soldier was wounded in the hip, both slightly...the third wounded is a Palestinian woman," a police spokeswoman said.
She said all three were taken to hospital and the assailant, a 29-year-old Palestinian from the West Bank town of Qalqilya, was arrested.

Israel radio said the woman opened fire on the bridge over the Jordan river as she approached Israeli guards after crossing a checkpoint on the Jordanian side of the border. Jordanian officials said the bridge was closed to passengers until further notice as investigations were carried out.
Jordan's minister of state for information affairs Samir Mutawae told Reuters the attack appeared to be an isolated act.
"All the indications up until now seem to suggest it's an individual incident with no political dimensions...but all the details are not available to us as yet," Mutawae said.
Passengers crossing the bridge from both the Israeli and Jordanian sides are not subject to body searchs but security measures were being reviewed in view of the incident, officials said.
Last month a Jordanian soldier shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls further north on the normally quiet Israeli-Jordanian border.
Middle East violence has flared since Israel broke ground on March 18 for a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

In the Gaza Strip on Sunday, the Israeli army said it defused a bomb planted at the Jewish settlement of Kfar Darom. In Hebron, Israeli soldiers clashed briefly with Palestinian youths after a bout of stone-throwing between Jewish settlers and Arabs in the partitioned West Bank town.
